findings.detail: approval_reaction_retires_triggers calls react through a helper that maps the Output to (), so no test checks that the reaction gives an Output with empty text.
later_failures_are_kept checks only that the second react succeeds and leaves the files unchanged; it never checks that the second run's Output has empty text.
